arxiv-2002-10078.title: On Hiding Neural Networks Inside Neural Networks
arxiv-2002-10078.creator: Chuan Guo, Ruihan Wu, Kilian Q. Weinberger
arxiv-2002-10078.description: Abstract Modern neural networks often contain significantly more parameters than the size of their training data. We show that this excess capacity provides an opportunity for embedding secret machine learning models within a trained neural network. Our novel framework hides the existence of a secret neural network with arbitrary desired functionality within a carrier network.

arxiv-2007-08225.title: Transition states and entangled mass action law
arxiv-2007-08225.creator: A.N. Gorban
arxiv-2007-08225.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by A.N. Gorban. The classical approaches to the derivation of the (generalized) Mass Action Law (MAL) assume that the intermediate transition state (i) has short life time and (ii) is in partial equilibrium with the initial reagents of the elementary reaction. The partial equilibrium assumption (ii) means that the reverse decomposition of the intermediates is much faster than its transition through other channels to the products. In this work we demonstrate how avoiding this partial equilibrium assumption modifies the reaction rates.

arxiv-2403-14286.description: Abstract Clustering speaker embeddings is crucial in speaker diarization but hasn’t received as much focus as other components. uslaw-usc-t18-s3300.title: 18 U.S.C. § 3300 — Recruitment or use of child soldiers
uslaw-usc-t18-s3300.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s3300.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part II (Criminal Procedure); Chapter 213 (Limitations). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No person may be prosecuted, tried, or punished for a violation of section 2442 unless the indictment or the information is filed not later than 10 years after the commission of the offense.

uslaw-usc-t7-s1636.title: 7 U.S.C. § 1636 — General provisions
uslaw-usc-t7-s1636.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s1636.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 38 (Distribution And Marketing Of Agricultural Products); Subchapter II (Livestock Mandatory Reporting); Part E (Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Confidentiality The Secretary shall make available to the public information, statistics, and documents obtained from, or submitted by, packers, retail entities, and other persons under this subchapter in a manner that ensures that confidentiality.
